mece_claim: Exhaustive over each declared pipeline-stage terminal outcome, not over provider-specific error causes. UNKNOWN is explicit; no status defaults to success. Plane types verification state and substrate types physical platform; neither field carries the other's intent.
construction_rule: KNOWN is constructible only for PRESENT/SUCCEEDED/SUCCEEDED/SUCCEEDED; every other status tuple constructs UNKNOWN with null value.

token_census_at_vintage.scope: repository text tokens before this schema act
token_census_at_vintage.interpretation: Existing generic spellings are adopted only for these field-scoped axes; this act does not mint a repository-global ontology.

four_postulates.mece: PASS: the three verification planes close declared/configured, landed/live-state, and path-exercised claims; the four substrates close the ratified physical platform partition.
four_postulates.same_grain: PASS: plane members each type one verification assertion; substrate members each type one physical platform partition.
four_postulates.intent_coherence: PASS: the former DESIRED_REPOSITORY fusion is removed; plane and substrate answer separate questions in separate fields.
four_postulates.state_coherence: PASS: each axis is re-evaluated from its own declared provenance rule; neither embeds a remedy or a value from the other axis.
